experiment_data.hypothesis: 在更强 misclassification-CATE 正相关、非均衡样本规模或 k=6 稀疏分组下，pooled/global correction 的欠校正/过校正误差会超过 observed-label 平滑收益，从而出现 global PEHE 或 GATE bias 劣于 uncorrected 的区域。

spec.data_count: k={3,6}, N={2000,5000}, reps=300 per config or seed x 100 equivalent
spec.device: CPU-only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; do not use cuda:0
spec.pass_fail: Pass if at least one predeclared positive-correlation stress config has global correction PEHE or GATE bias worse than uncorrected and subgroup/EC-HTE-lite improves PEHE/GATE bias or coverage; fail if no global-worse region appears across k/N grid.
